meta.title: Matters of the Past
meta.description: Long, long ago, there was a vast ocean on the other side of my memories.

units.rawText: <cmdr>~ Are you sure you don't need my help?
units.displayText: {교수}~ Are you sure you don't need my help?

spans.text: ~ Are you sure you don't need my help?

units.rawText: Sangoma watches me analyze the data, her face resting lightly on her hand. There's a hint of affection in her caring voice.
units.displayText: Sangoma watches me analyze the data, her face resting lightly on her hand. There's a hint of affection in her caring voice.

spans.text: Sangoma watches me analyze the data, her face resting lightly on her hand. There's a hint of affection in her caring voice.

units.rawText: I thought I finally had the chance to talk with you alone, but instead, you're ignoring me and focusing on your little gizmos...
units.displayText: I thought I finally had the chance to talk with you alone, but instead, you're ignoring me and focusing on your little gizmos...

spans.text: I thought I finally had the chance to talk with you alone, but instead, you're ignoring me and focusing on your little gizmos...

units.rawText: Have I become so old now that I've become less useful than a mere machine? Sniff-sniff...
units.displayText: Have I become so old now that I've become less useful than a mere machine? Sniff-sniff...

spans.text: Have I become so old now that I've become less useful than a mere machine? Sniff-sniff...

units.rawText: ...I'm just analyzing the fragment.
units.displayText: ...I'm just analyzing the fragment.

spans.text: ...I'm just analyzing the fragment.

units.rawText: Then it should be clear to you, no? The two fragments align, but the combined data remains indecipherable.
units.displayText: Then it should be clear to you, no? The two fragments align, but the combined data remains indecipherable.

spans.text: Then it should be clear to you, no? The two fragments align, but the combined data remains indecipherable.

units.rawText: I project the memory from the fragment into the air, attempting to play it.
units.displayText: I project the memory from the fragment into the air, attempting to play it.

spans.text: I project the memory from the fragment into the air, attempting to play it.

units.rawText: The imagery from the memory is corrupted—tearing, low-resolution visuals paired with desynchronized audio tracks. Together, they resemble scenes from a low-budget horror film.
units.displayText: The imagery from the memory is corrupted—tearing, low-resolution visuals paired with desynchronized audio tracks. Together, they resemble scenes from a low-budget horror film.

spans.text: The imagery from the memory is corrupted—tearing, low-resolution visuals paired with desynchronized audio tracks. Together, they resemble scenes from a low-budget horror film.

units.rawText: Based on its condition, it appears to have suffered a heavy impact. However, I can't quite fathom what kind of force could cause this level of damage to a memory fragment...
units.displayText: Based on its condition, it appears to have suffered a heavy impact. However, I can't quite fathom what kind of force could cause this level of damage to a memory fragment...

spans.text: Based on its condition, it appears to have suffered a heavy impact. However, I can't quite fathom what kind of force could cause this level of damage to a memory fragment...

units.rawText: Hey, don't look at me like that. I'm not the kind of person who goes around shredding other people's memories for fun.
units.displayText: Hey, don't look at me like that. I'm not the kind of person who goes around shredding other people's memories for fun.

spans.text: Hey, don't look at me like that. I'm not the kind of person who goes around shredding other people's memories for fun.

units.rawText: I don't doubt you. This kind of memory corruption is clearly not artificial.
units.displayText: I don't doubt you. This kind of memory corruption is clearly not artificial.

spans.text: I don't doubt you. This kind of memory corruption is clearly not artificial.

units.rawText: Right now, I'm referencing the ENIAC database to analyze and repair the corrupted data while searching for clues about what happened to it.
units.displayText: Right now, I'm referencing the ENIAC database to analyze and repair the corrupted data while searching for clues about what happened to it.

spans.text: Right now, I'm referencing the ENIAC database to analyze and repair the corrupted data while searching for clues about what happened to it.

units.rawText: You could've just asked me about something this trivial. Why take the long way around trying to figure it out on your own?
units.displayText: You could've just asked me about something this trivial. Why take the long way around trying to figure it out on your own?

spans.text: You could've just asked me about something this trivial. Why take the long way around trying to figure it out on your own?

units.rawText: Human memories, and the way they're described, are always blurry and inaccurate. Besides, I suspect you're eager to explore the details stored in the fragment.
units.displayText: Human memories, and the way they're described, are always blurry and inaccurate. Besides, I suspect you're eager to explore the details stored in the fragment.

spans.text: Human memories, and the way they're described, are always blurry and inaccurate. Besides, I suspect you're eager to explore the details stored in the fragment.

units.rawText: The Doll, who was just lounging on the sofa, now looks at me with shimmering eyes full of admiration. She clasps her hands together and comes over to stand by my side.
units.displayText: The Doll, who was just lounging on the sofa, now looks at me with shimmering eyes full of admiration. She clasps her hands together and comes over to stand by my side.

spans.text: The Doll, who was just lounging on the sofa, now looks at me with shimmering eyes full of admiration. She clasps her hands together and comes over to stand by my side.

units.rawText: ...It's only been a little while since we last met, but you've already grown so dependable.
units.displayText: ...It's only been a little while since we last met, but you've already grown so dependable.

spans.text: ...It's only been a little while since we last met, but you've already grown so dependable.

units.rawText: But sometimes, it's the blurriness that helps fit all the pieces together.
units.displayText: But sometimes, it's the blurriness that helps fit all the pieces together.

spans.text: But sometimes, it's the blurriness that helps fit all the pieces together.

units.rawText: As if compelled by Sangoma's words, the machine concludes its search and analysis, marking its completion with a loud beep.
units.displayText: As if compelled by Sangoma's words, the machine concludes its search and analysis, marking its completion with a loud beep.

spans.text: As if compelled by Sangoma's words, the machine concludes its search and analysis, marking its completion with a loud beep.

units.rawText: No solutions found. As expected, you can't just run the same routine that you would whilst fixing a Doll's memory.
units.displayText: No solutions found. As expected, you can't just run the same routine that you would whilst fixing a Doll's memory.

spans.text: No solutions found. As expected, you can't just run the same routine that you would whilst fixing a Doll's memory.

units.rawText: Professor, I've also got my results.
units.displayText: Professor, I've also got my results.

spans.text: Professor, I've also got my results.

units.rawText: ...I'm sorry, but the damage is too severe. We can't send you into the past memory through the fragment as we did before.
units.displayText: ...I'm sorry, but the damage is too severe. We can't send you into the past memory through the fragment as we did before.

spans.text: ...I'm sorry, but the damage is too severe. We can't send you into the past memory through the fragment as we did before.

units.rawText: It's okay... I understand.
units.displayText: It's okay... I understand.

spans.text: It's okay... I understand.

units.rawText: But to my knowledge, there are other methods to restore memory data. Perhaps we could give those a try...
units.displayText: But to my knowledge, there are other methods to restore memory data. Perhaps we could give those a try...

spans.text: But to my knowledge, there are other methods to restore memory data. Perhaps we could give those a try...

units.rawText: I hate to discourage you two further, but what works on a Doll won't work on a human.
units.displayText: I hate to discourage you two further, but what works on a Doll won't work on a human.

spans.text: I hate to discourage you two further, but what works on a Doll won't work on a human.

units.rawText: I... know a Doll who tried for so long to restore a human's memory, but in the end, it was all in vain.
units.displayText: I... know a Doll who tried for so long to restore a human's memory, but in the end, it was all in vain.

spans.text: I... know a Doll who tried for so long to restore a human's memory, but in the end, it was all in vain.

units.rawText: Persicaria, given your expertise in AI, you should be aware of the distinction here.
units.displayText: Persicaria, given your expertise in AI, you should be aware of the distinction here.

spans.text: Persicaria, given your expertise in AI, you should be aware of the distinction here.

units.rawText: Persicaria's ears, which have been perked up, now droop as Sangoma's blunt words reach her.
units.displayText: Persicaria's ears, which have been perked up, now droop as Sangoma's blunt words reach her.

spans.text: Persicaria's ears, which have been perked up, now droop as Sangoma's blunt words reach her.

units.rawText: ...It's true that Dolls encode past events into data, whereas humans store them as "memory."
units.displayText: ...It's true that Dolls encode past events into data, whereas humans store them as "memory."

spans.text: ...It's true that Dolls encode past events into data, whereas humans store them as "memory."

units.rawText: For humans, memories function more like a network, with each interwoven, interconnected to one another.
units.displayText: For humans, memories function more like a network, with each interwoven, interconnected to one another.

spans.text: For humans, memories function more like a network, with each interwoven, interconnected to one another.

units.rawText: ...You're correct. When compared to our conventional data repair methods, replicating the way humans process memories seems like a more effective approach.
units.displayText: ...You're correct. When compared to our conventional data repair methods, replicating the way humans process memories seems like a more effective approach.

spans.text: ...You're correct. When compared to our conventional data repair methods, replicating the way humans process memories seems like a more effective approach.

units.rawText: As an eureka moment strikes, Persicaria's fingers race across the keyboard, swiftly compiling her thoughts.
units.displayText: As an eureka moment strikes, Persicaria's fingers race across the keyboard, swiftly compiling her thoughts.

spans.text: As an eureka moment strikes, Persicaria's fingers race across the keyboard, swiftly compiling her thoughts.

units.rawText: Professor, I've found a way that might be reliable from the references.
units.displayText: Professor, I've found a way that might be reliable from the references.

spans.text: Professor, I've found a way that might be reliable from the references.

units.rawText: Like Madam Sangoma said, human memory works differently from a Doll's. It functions as an interconnected web, and when it's damaged, the symptoms are more severe and it's far more difficult to repair compared to a Doll's memory.
units.displayText: Like Madam Sangoma said, human memory works differently from a Doll's. It functions as an interconnected web, and when it's damaged, the symptoms are more severe and it's far more difficult to repair compared to a Doll's memory.

spans.text: Like Madam Sangoma said, human memory works differently from a Doll's. It functions as an interconnected web, and when it's damaged, the symptoms are more severe and it's far more difficult to repair compared to a Doll's memory.

units.rawText: But it also means that we can leverage this interconnectivity to reverse the damage.
units.displayText: But it also means that we can leverage this interconnectivity to reverse the damage.

spans.text: But it also means that we can leverage this interconnectivity to reverse the damage.

units.rawText: We'll arrange for you to speak with each relevant Doll to stimulate the part of your brain responsible for memory. Then, we'll see if you can restore the partial pieces of memory associated with that Doll.
units.displayText: We'll arrange for you to speak with each relevant Doll to stimulate the part of your brain responsible for memory. Then, we'll see if you can restore the partial pieces of memory associated with that Doll.

spans.text: We'll arrange for you to speak with each relevant Doll to stimulate the part of your brain responsible for memory. Then, we'll see if you can restore the partial pieces of memory associated with that Doll.

units.rawText: Once the partial restoration is confirmed, we'll continue the process, gradually piecing all the missing memories together.
units.displayText: Once the partial restoration is confirmed, we'll continue the process, gradually piecing all the missing memories together.

spans.text: Once the partial restoration is confirmed, we'll continue the process, gradually piecing all the missing memories together.

units.rawText: This is only a hypothesis based on what we have as reference, but I'll start testing it right away. If it proves ineffective, we'll explore alternative methods.
units.displayText: This is only a hypothesis based on what we have as reference, but I'll start testing it right away. If it proves ineffective, we'll explore alternative methods.

spans.text: This is only a hypothesis based on what we have as reference, but I'll start testing it right away. If it proves ineffective, we'll explore alternative methods.

units.rawText: To have improvised a solution in such a short time... You've truly inherited "Dr. Persica's" renowned talent in neuroscience.
units.displayText: To have improvised a solution in such a short time... You've truly inherited "Dr. Persica's" renowned talent in neuroscience.

spans.text: To have improvised a solution in such a short time... You've truly inherited "Dr. Persica's" renowned talent in neuroscience.

units.rawText: Sangoma is reading the references Persicaria found with great interest. Persicaria pauses in surprise as she hears that long-unheard yet familiar form of address, but she quickly returns to her determined self.
units.displayText: Sangoma is reading the references Persicaria found with great interest. Persicaria pauses in surprise as she hears that long-unheard yet familiar form of address, but she quickly returns to her determined self.

spans.text: Sangoma is reading the references Persicaria found with great interest. Persicaria pauses in surprise as she hears that long-unheard yet familiar form of address, but she quickly returns to her determined self.

units.rawText: Thanks for your compliment, Madam Sangoma. The Doctor and I may look alike, but I'm not her replica.
units.displayText: Thanks for your compliment, Madam Sangoma. The Doctor and I may look alike, but I'm not her replica.

spans.text: Thanks for your compliment, Madam Sangoma. The Doctor and I may look alike, but I'm not her replica.

units.rawText: I'm sure both the Professor and Dr. Persica herself would agree with that.
units.displayText: I'm sure both the Professor and Dr. Persica herself would agree with that.

spans.text: I'm sure both the Professor and Dr. Persica herself would agree with that.

units.rawText: Persicaria turns to me, and I smile back to show affirmation.
units.displayText: Persicaria turns to me, and I smile back to show affirmation.

spans.text: Persicaria turns to me, and I smile back to show affirmation.

units.rawText: ...Oh dear, how rude of me. I'll keep that in mind.
units.displayText: ...Oh dear, how rude of me. I'll keep that in mind.

spans.text: ...Oh dear, how rude of me. I'll keep that in mind.

units.rawText: We don't have much time. Let's move forward with Persicaria's plan. Persicaria, can I leave it to you to arrange the schedule for the other Dolls involved?
units.displayText: We don't have much time. Let's move forward with Persicaria's plan. Persicaria, can I leave it to you to arrange the schedule for the other Dolls involved?

spans.text: We don't have much time. Let's move forward with Persicaria's plan. Persicaria, can I leave it to you to arrange the schedule for the other Dolls involved?

units.rawText: Of course. I'll make the arrangements. Contact me anytime if you need anything, Professor.
units.displayText: Of course. I'll make the arrangements. Contact me anytime if you need anything, Professor.

spans.text: Of course. I'll make the arrangements. Contact me anytime if you need anything, Professor.

units.rawText: The call ends, and the light from the monitor casts a glow on Sangoma's cheek.
units.displayText: The call ends, and the light from the monitor casts a glow on Sangoma's cheek.

spans.text: The call ends, and the light from the monitor casts a glow on Sangoma's cheek.

units.rawText: ...Do you know Persicaria well?
units.displayText: ...Do you know Persicaria well?

spans.text: ...Do you know Persicaria well?

units.rawText: I wouldn't say that I do. Just a few things I've learned along the way... In fact, she's far more talented than I had anticipated.
units.displayText: I wouldn't say that I do. Just a few things I've learned along the way... In fact, she's far more talented than I had anticipated.

spans.text: I wouldn't say that I do. Just a few things I've learned along the way... In fact, she's far more talented than I had anticipated.

units.rawText: I didn't expect her to find a way out so quickly with the little information I gave her.
units.displayText: I didn't expect her to find a way out so quickly with the little information I gave her.

spans.text: I didn't expect her to find a way out so quickly with the little information I gave her.

units.rawText: Not only you, but your Dolls have come so far as well... It makes me feel like I'm the one being left behind.
units.displayText: Not only you, but your Dolls have come so far as well... It makes me feel like I'm the one being left behind.

spans.text: Not only you, but your Dolls have come so far as well... It makes me feel like I'm the one being left behind.

units.rawText: I don't know how to respond. Sangoma quickly returns to her usual expression, as if that brief expression of forlorn loneliness had never appeared on her face.
units.displayText: I don't know how to respond. Sangoma quickly returns to her usual expression, as if that brief expression of forlorn loneliness had never appeared on her face.

spans.text: I don't know how to respond. Sangoma quickly returns to her usual expression, as if that brief expression of forlorn loneliness had never appeared on her face.

units.rawText: Persicaria has done more than enough. We should get to work and try her method.
units.displayText: Persicaria has done more than enough. We should get to work and try her method.

spans.text: Persicaria has done more than enough. We should get to work and try her method.

units.rawText: ...Are you saying...
units.displayText: ...Are you saying...

spans.text: ...Are you saying...

units.rawText: Let me share some stories from the past.
units.displayText: Let me share some stories from the past.

spans.text: Let me share some stories from the past.

units.rawText: Although I don't know your past in full, I'm confident I can guide you back to your memories.
units.displayText: Although I don't know your past in full, I'm confident I can guide you back to your memories.

spans.text: Although I don't know your past in full, I'm confident I can guide you back to your memories.

units.rawText: ...So, this is what you had in mind all along?
units.displayText: ...So, this is what you had in mind all along?

spans.text: ...So, this is what you had in mind all along?

units.rawText: Mm, you've no idea how much preparation I've put into this.
units.displayText: Mm, you've no idea how much preparation I've put into this.

spans.text: Mm, you've no idea how much preparation I've put into this.

units.rawText: She smiles softly as she invites me. As I look at her face, that hazy feeling of familiarity resurfaces.
units.displayText: She smiles softly as she invites me. As I look at her face, that hazy feeling of familiarity resurfaces.

spans.text: She smiles softly as she invites me. As I look at her face, that hazy feeling of familiarity resurfaces.

units.rawText: My hand moves to hers instinctively, with our palms touching one another. A wave of warmth and tranquility flows through the connection.
units.displayText: My hand moves to hers instinctively, with our palms touching one another. A wave of warmth and tranquility flows through the connection.

spans.text: My hand moves to hers instinctively, with our palms touching one another. A wave of warmth and tranquility flows through the connection.

units.rawText: Like I promised, I'll do whatever it takes to help you complete this fragmented story.
units.displayText: Like I promised, I'll do whatever it takes to help you complete this fragmented story.

spans.text: Like I promised, I'll do whatever it takes to help you complete this fragmented story.

units.displayText: ...Mind Parsing Complete.

units.displayText: ...Connecting to Magrasea Cloud Server.

units.displayText: ...Is the sensory system still not online?

units.rawText: I fail to make a sound, and thus, no one responds. After what feels like an eternity in silence, a cold, synthetic voice emanates from the void.
units.displayText: I fail to make a sound, and thus, no one responds. After what feels like an eternity in silence, a cold, synthetic voice emanates from the void.

spans.text: I fail to make a sound, and thus, no one responds. After what feels like an eternity in silence, a cold, synthetic voice emanates from the void.

units.rawText: What are you?
units.displayText: What are you?

spans.text: What are you?

units.rawText: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?
units.displayText: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?

spans.text: My words didn't leave my mouth, yet the voice acknowledged my response. Is this someone hidden by the darkness, or does it come from the will of the darkness itself? Or am I just talking to myself?

units.rawText: Yes, you.
units.displayText: Yes, you.

spans.text: Yes, you.

units.rawText: You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?
units.displayText: You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?

spans.text: You, who was born in this world—are you a human, an angel, or God?

units.rawText: I lose myself along with my senses. I struggle to find the answer in my memories, but whatever past experience I've had tells me they aren't looking for a textbook answer.
units.displayText: I lose myself along with my senses. I struggle to find the answer in my memories, but whatever past experience I've had tells me they aren't looking for a textbook answer.

options.displayText: (...What's the line between humans and God?)

(...It's a nuanced question.)
(I am God!)

units.rawText: I start to feel my arms again. I want to reach out and touch the source of that voice, but they elude me.
units.displayText: I start to feel my arms again. I want to reach out and touch the source of that voice, but they elude me.

spans.text: I start to feel my arms again. I want to reach out and touch the source of that voice, but they elude me.

units.rawText: Now is not the time you get to know me.
units.displayText: Now is not the time you get to know me.

spans.text: Now is not the time you get to know me.

units.rawText: Your sensory system isn't fully online yet. Premature contact could lead to unwanted complications.
units.displayText: Your sensory system isn't fully online yet. Premature contact could lead to unwanted complications.

spans.text: Your sensory system isn't fully online yet. Premature contact could lead to unwanted complications.

units.rawText: (Complications? What do you mean...)
units.displayText: Complications? What do you mean...

spans.text: Complications? What do you mean...

units.rawText: Shhh... Keep quiet.
units.displayText: Shhh... Keep quiet.

spans.text: Shhh... Keep quiet.

units.rawText: ...The pests are coming.
units.displayText: ...The pests are coming.

spans.text: ...The pests are coming.

units.rawText: My vision is still impaired, yet I instinctively try to follow the source of the voice with my eyes.
units.displayText: My vision is still impaired, yet I instinctively try to follow the source of the voice with my eyes.

spans.text: My vision is still impaired, yet I instinctively try to follow the source of the voice with my eyes.

units.displayText: [Sanctifier No. PG-U, arriving at the anomalous signal.]

units.displayText: [Agent detected. Identifying...]

units.displayText: [Identification succeeee...]

units.displayText: It suddenly glitches. Its synthetic voiceline is drowned out by electrical hums, unnervingly repeating the broken message.

units.rawText: (What... have I gotten myself into?)
units.displayText: What... have I gotten myself into?

spans.text: What... have I gotten myself into?

units.rawText: The warning alarms grow more prevalent, closing in around me. Although I'm not familiar with their vocabulary, it's clear that the situation doesn't afford me the luxury to explain myself or study their words.
units.displayText: The warning alarms grow more prevalent, closing in around me. Although I'm not familiar with their vocabulary, it's clear that the situation doesn't afford me the luxury to explain myself or study their words.

spans.text: The warning alarms grow more prevalent, closing in around me. Although I'm not familiar with their vocabulary, it's clear that the situation doesn't afford me the luxury to explain myself or study their words.

units.rawText: Watch out.
units.displayText: Watch out.

spans.text: Watch out.

units.rawText: A strong push shoves me away. In the next second, explosions and gunshots tear through the place I just vacated.
units.displayText: A strong push shoves me away. In the next second, explosions and gunshots tear through the place I just vacated.

spans.text: A strong push shoves me away. In the next second, explosions and gunshots tear through the place I just vacated.

units.rawText: Stay out of range of their attacks.
units.displayText: Stay out of range of their attacks.

spans.text: Stay out of range of their attacks.

units.rawText: Wait here for a moment. I'll be back once I've dealt with the annoying ones.
units.displayText: Wait here for a moment. I'll be back once I've dealt with the annoying ones.

spans.text: Wait here for a moment. I'll be back once I've dealt with the annoying ones.

units.rawText: I feel my body enveloped in a soft material, gradually pushing me away from the danger.
units.displayText: I feel my body enveloped in a soft material, gradually pushing me away from the danger.

spans.text: I feel my body enveloped in a soft material, gradually pushing me away from the danger.

units.rawText: Before I can utter a word, the voice's master leaves, taking the robotic noises with them.
units.displayText: Before I can utter a word, the voice's master leaves, taking the robotic noises with them.

spans.text: Before I can utter a word, the voice's master leaves, taking the robotic noises with them.

units.rawText: My hearing gradually returns, and I begin to hear the sounds of artillery fire and metal clashing.
units.displayText: My hearing gradually returns, and I begin to hear the sounds of artillery fire and metal clashing.

spans.text: My hearing gradually returns, and I begin to hear the sounds of artillery fire and metal clashing.

units.rawText: I want to better comprehend the situation, but the mounting fatigue resurfaces, pulling my mind back into the darkness.
units.displayText: I want to better comprehend the situation, but the mounting fatigue resurfaces, pulling my mind back into the darkness.

spans.text: I want to better comprehend the situation, but the mounting fatigue resurfaces, pulling my mind back into the darkness.

units.rawText: I haven't fully regained my senses, but my lungs recognize the world before my eyes.
units.displayText: I haven't fully regained my senses, but my lungs recognize the world before my eyes.

spans.text: I haven't fully regained my senses, but my lungs recognize the world before my eyes.

units.rawText:
My nose twitches. A gentle, sweet fragrance slowly fills my senses—a scent impossible to find on a battlefield thick with the smoke of gunpowder.
A faint electrical hum buzzes weakly like a tiny insect. It flutters through the imaginary form of my body, dancing out of sight.

units.rawText: Embracing this entirely new experience, I find myself hoping the light will return.
units.displayText: Embracing this entirely new experience, I find myself hoping the light will return.

spans.text: Embracing this entirely new experience, I find myself hoping the light will return.

units.rawText: Poof—
units.displayText: Poof—

spans.text: Poof—

units.rawText: I have no idea how long has passed, but a soft sensation beneath my body stirs me awake.
units.displayText: I have no idea how long has passed, but a soft sensation beneath my body stirs me awake.

spans.text: I have no idea how long has passed, but a soft sensation beneath my body stirs me awake.

units.rawText: I barely manage to lift my heavy eyelids. A slender ray of light slips through the gap, revealing the world's true image to my weary eyes.
units.displayText: I barely manage to lift my heavy eyelids. A slender ray of light slips through the gap, revealing the world's true image to my weary eyes.

spans.text: I barely manage to lift my heavy eyelids. A slender ray of light slips through the gap, revealing the world's true image to my weary eyes.

units.rawText: Hey, you're awake. Good morning~
units.displayText: Hey, you're awake. Good morning~

spans.text: Hey, you're awake. Good morning~

units.rawText: You were in serious danger back there. Good thing I got there in time and dealt with those Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: You were in serious danger back there. Good thing I got there in time and dealt with those Sanctifiers.

spans.text: You were in serious danger back there. Good thing I got there in time and dealt with those Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: How are you doing? Feeling anything unusual? Let me know right away if you don't feel right.
units.displayText: How are you doing? Feeling anything unusual? Let me know right away if you don't feel right.

spans.text: How are you doing? Feeling anything unusual? Let me know right away if you don't feel right.

units.rawText: When I first entered this emulated world, I expected to see scenes tied to the Cloud, yet here I am, looking at a woman I don't even know.
units.displayText: When I first entered this emulated world, I expected to see scenes tied to the Cloud, yet here I am, looking at a woman I don't even know.

spans.text: When I first entered this emulated world, I expected to see scenes tied to the Cloud, yet here I am, looking at a woman I don't even know.

units.rawText: Lying on her lap, my vision is fully occupied by her presence. I can't even see the sky of the Cloud.
units.displayText: Lying on her lap, my vision is fully occupied by her presence. I can't even see the sky of the Cloud.

spans.text: Lying on her lap, my vision is fully occupied by her presence. I can't even see the sky of the Cloud.

units.rawText: Hm? Can you hear me? I should've checked your auditory system...
units.displayText: Hm? Can you hear me? I should've checked your auditory system...

spans.text: Hm? Can you hear me? I should've checked your auditory system...

units.rawText: ...I'm hearing you just fine.
units.displayText: ...I'm hearing you just fine.

spans.text: ...I'm hearing you just fine.

units.rawText: Oh, good! Hold on a moment while I run some check-ups on you. You'll be able to move soon.
units.displayText: Oh, good! Hold on a moment while I run some check-ups on you. You'll be able to move soon.

spans.text: Oh, good! Hold on a moment while I run some check-ups on you. You'll be able to move soon.

options.rawText: (Stay lying down for a little longer.)
options.displayText: (Stay lying down for a little longer.)

spans.text: (Stay lying down for a little longer.)
(I should stand up first.)

units.rawText: Good! Just a little bit longer.
units.displayText: Good! Just a little bit longer.

spans.text: Good! Just a little bit longer.

units.rawText: My body is still slightly numb. I lay on her lap, watching her work through the check-ups, grateful for this warmth that's hard to come by.
units.displayText: My body is still slightly numb. I lay on her lap, watching her work through the check-ups, grateful for this warmth that's hard to come by.

spans.text: My body is still slightly numb. I lay on her lap, watching her work through the check-ups, grateful for this warmth that's hard to come by.

units.rawText: I struggle to get up, only to be stopped by her gentle yet firm push.
units.displayText: I struggle to get up, only to be stopped by her gentle yet firm push.

spans.text: I struggle to get up, only to be stopped by her gentle yet firm push.

units.rawText: Don't be so impatient. You could end up in serious trouble if there are any problems left unchecked. Just trust me on this, okay?
units.displayText: Don't be so impatient. You could end up in serious trouble if there are any problems left unchecked. Just trust me on this, okay?

spans.text: Don't be so impatient. You could end up in serious trouble if there are any problems left unchecked. Just trust me on this, okay?

units.rawText: She may look physically weak, but her strength far surpasses mine. I give in to her unwavering, almost commanding presence and stay resting on her lap in obedience.
units.displayText: She may look physically weak, but her strength far surpasses mine. I give in to her unwavering, almost commanding presence and stay resting on her lap in obedience.

spans.text: She may look physically weak, but her strength far surpasses mine. I give in to her unwavering, almost commanding presence and stay resting on her lap in obedience.

units.rawText: Thanks to her gentle touch and unique fragrance, I finally begin to calm down in this unfamiliar world.
units.displayText: Thanks to her gentle touch and unique fragrance, I finally begin to calm down in this unfamiliar world.

spans.text: Thanks to her gentle touch and unique fragrance, I finally begin to calm down in this unfamiliar world.

units.rawText: Check-up complete. All systems functional. No injuries.
units.displayText: Check-up complete. All systems functional. No injuries.

spans.text: Check-up complete. All systems functional. No injuries.

units.rawText: You sure are lucky.
units.displayText: You sure are lucky.

spans.text: You sure are lucky.

units.rawText: Although she says I'm perfectly fine, she still won't let me get up. She lowers her head to look at me. Her large conical hat blocks the light and adds a slight sense of pressure.
units.displayText: Although she says I'm perfectly fine, she still won't let me get up. She lowers her head to look at me. Her large conical hat blocks the light and adds a slight sense of pressure.

spans.text: Although she says I'm perfectly fine, she still won't let me get up. She lowers her head to look at me. Her large conical hat blocks the light and adds a slight sense of pressure.

units.rawText: You're a human, right? This world is too dangerous for your kind. What brings you here?
units.displayText: You're a human, right? This world is too dangerous for your kind. What brings you here?

spans.text: You're a human, right? This world is too dangerous for your kind. What brings you here?

units.rawText: Her voice remains calm and gentle, yet I can feel the subtle probing and threats behind her question.
units.displayText: Her voice remains calm and gentle, yet I can feel the subtle probing and threats behind her question.

spans.text: Her voice remains calm and gentle, yet I can feel the subtle probing and threats behind her question.

units.rawText: It reminds me of Dr. Persica's words before I was uploaded to the Cloud.
units.displayText: It reminds me of Dr. Persica's words before I was uploaded to the Cloud.

spans.text: It reminds me of Dr. Persica's words before I was uploaded to the Cloud.

units.rawText: I will no longer be able to contact you once you enter the cloud server, so remember your mission:
units.displayText: I will no longer be able to contact you once you enter the cloud server, so remember your mission:

spans.text: I will no longer be able to contact you once you enter the cloud server, so remember your mission:

units.rawText: Find a way to connect with reality and bring my friend – that Professor – and the Dolls trapped in the cloud server home.
units.displayText: Find a way to connect with reality and bring my friend – that Professor – and the Dolls trapped in the cloud server home.

spans.text: Find a way to connect with reality and bring my friend – that Professor – and the Dolls trapped in the cloud server home.

units.rawText: Also, for our safety, make sure to keep your identity secret and tell nobody about it.
units.displayText: Also, for our safety, make sure to keep your identity secret and tell nobody about it.

spans.text: Also, for our safety, make sure to keep your identity secret and tell nobody about it.

units.rawText: This may end up being a long journey, but I believe you will be able to save them.
units.displayText: This may end up being a long journey, but I believe you will be able to save them.

spans.text: This may end up being a long journey, but I believe you will be able to save them.

units.rawText: That's all. Good luck, "Professor".
units.displayText: That's all. Good luck, "Professor".

spans.text: That's all. Good luck, "Professor".
State my identity and purpose.

options.rawText: Claim that I'm a normal Agent.
options.displayText: Claim that I'm a normal Agent.

spans.text: Claim that I'm a normal Agent.
Try to counter-probe.

units.rawText: ...I'm just another Agent, not a human.
units.displayText: ...I'm just another Agent, not a human.

spans.text: ...I'm just another Agent, not a human.

units.rawText: I don't like liars. Your neural cloud structure is clearly distinct from Agents and Dolls. I'll give you one more chance—answer honestly. Do you understand?
units.displayText: I don't like liars. Your neural cloud structure is clearly distinct from Agents and Dolls. I'll give you one more chance—answer honestly. Do you understand?

spans.text: I don't like liars. Your neural cloud structure is clearly distinct from Agents and Dolls. I'll give you one more chance—answer honestly. Do you understand?

units.rawText: My identity is nothing interesting. I'm more curious about you. Who are you? Why did you help me?
units.displayText: My identity is nothing interesting. I'm more curious about you. Who are you? Why did you help me?

spans.text: My identity is nothing interesting. I'm more curious about you. Who are you? Why did you help me?

units.rawText: I asked my question first. Answer mine, and I'll answer yours. Sound fair?
units.displayText: I asked my question first. Answer mine, and I'll answer yours. Sound fair?

spans.text: I asked my question first. Answer mine, and I'll answer yours. Sound fair?

units.rawText: Her physique and tone are more akin to a Doll from reality than a standard Agent. Regardless, playing mind games here is not a wise option.
units.displayText: Her physique and tone are more akin to a Doll from reality than a standard Agent. Regardless, playing mind games here is not a wise option.

spans.text: Her physique and tone are more akin to a Doll from reality than a standard Agent. Regardless, playing mind games here is not a wise option.

units.rawText: ...I'm the director of Project Neural Cloud. You can call me Professor <cmdr>.
units.displayText: ...I'm the director of Project Neural Cloud. You can call me Professor {교수}.

spans.text: ...I'm the director of Project Neural Cloud. You can call me Professor

units.rawText: Oh?
units.displayText: Oh?

spans.text: Oh?

units.rawText: A brief frown crosses her face, but it's quickly replaced by a smile.
units.displayText: A brief frown crosses her face, but it's quickly replaced by a smile.

spans.text: A brief frown crosses her face, but it's quickly replaced by a smile.

units.rawText: That's great. I'm one of the Dolls who joined the project. I thought you humans had abandoned us, so it's nice to see you again.
units.displayText: That's great. I'm one of the Dolls who joined the project. I thought you humans had abandoned us, so it's nice to see you again.

spans.text: That's great. I'm one of the Dolls who joined the project. I thought you humans had abandoned us, so it's nice to see you again.

units.rawText: The feeling's mutual. I'm here to help you find your way back to reality.
units.displayText: The feeling's mutual. I'm here to help you find your way back to reality.

spans.text: The feeling's mutual. I'm here to help you find your way back to reality.

units.rawText: If that's the case, I'll keep protecting you, but only if you're telling the truth.
units.displayText: If that's the case, I'll keep protecting you, but only if you're telling the truth.

spans.text: If that's the case, I'll keep protecting you, but only if you're telling the truth.

units.rawText: She placed heavy emphasis on the conditional part of the sentence. Then, she introduces herself after a formal salute.
units.displayText: She placed heavy emphasis on the conditional part of the sentence. Then, she introduces herself after a formal salute.

spans.text: She placed heavy emphasis on the conditional part of the sentence. Then, she introduces herself after a formal salute.

units.rawText: Now it's my turn to introduce myself. Model UL-TMR, Sangoma, an ordinary herbalist at Ultilife, at your service.
units.displayText: Now it's my turn to introduce myself. Model UL-TMR, Sangoma, an ordinary herbalist at Ultilife, at your service.

spans.text: Now it's my turn to introduce myself. Model UL-TMR, Sangoma, an ordinary herbalist at Ultilife, at your service.

units.rawText: Calling you "Professor" doesn't really sit quite right with me, so I'll just call you <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Calling you "Professor" doesn't really sit quite right with me, so I'll just call you {교수}.

spans.text: Calling you "Professor" doesn't really sit quite right with me, so I'll just call you

units.rawText: ...Okay.
units.displayText: ...Okay.

spans.text: ...Okay.

units.rawText: This game of lies always makes me feel a bit awkward. I clear my throat and change the subject.
units.displayText: This game of lies always makes me feel a bit awkward. I clear my throat and change the subject.

spans.text: This game of lies always makes me feel a bit awkward. I clear my throat and change the subject.

units.rawText: Speaking of which, we're in a deserted area, and I don't see any herbs growing here. What's a herbalist doing in a place like this?
units.displayText: Speaking of which, we're in a deserted area, and I don't see any herbs growing here. What's a herbalist doing in a place like this?

spans.text: Speaking of which, we're in a deserted area, and I don't see any herbs growing here. What's a herbalist doing in a place like this?

units.rawText: Umm... I was just passing by and noticed this group of Sanctifiers gathering here, so I stopped and took a look out of curiosity.
units.displayText: Umm... I was just passing by and noticed this group of Sanctifiers gathering here, so I stopped and took a look out of curiosity.

spans.text: Umm... I was just passing by and noticed this group of Sanctifiers gathering here, so I stopped and took a look out of curiosity.

units.rawText: <color=orange>Sanctifiers?</color>
units.displayText: Sanctifiers?

spans.text: Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: I recall the robotic voice from when my senses were still recovering. It seemed to mention that word somewhere.
units.displayText: I recall the robotic voice from when my senses were still recovering. It seemed to mention that word somewhere.

spans.text: I recall the robotic voice from when my senses were still recovering. It seemed to mention that word somewhere.

units.displayText: [Identification succeeee...]

units.displayText: It suddenly glitches. Its synthetic voiceline is drowned out by electrical hums, unnervingly repeating the broken message.

units.rawText: The robotic voice I just heard... are they what you refer to as Sanctifiers?
units.displayText: The robotic voice I just heard... are they what you refer to as Sanctifiers?

spans.text: The robotic voice I just heard... are they what you refer to as Sanctifiers?

units.rawText: Huh, you don't know about the Sanctifiers? Hmm... That means your knowledge about the Cloud is quite limited. That's not good...
units.displayText: Huh, you don't know about the Sanctifiers? Hmm... That means your knowledge about the Cloud is quite limited. That's not good...

spans.text: Huh, you don't know about the Sanctifiers? Hmm... That means your knowledge about the Cloud is quite limited. That's not good...

units.rawText: But don't worry. I'll fill you in piece by piece. I'm pretty good at teaching.
units.displayText: But don't worry. I'll fill you in piece by piece. I'm pretty good at teaching.

spans.text: But don't worry. I'll fill you in piece by piece. I'm pretty good at teaching.

units.rawText: Sangoma moves in closer, then points her finger at my chest.
units.displayText: Sangoma moves in closer, then points her finger at my chest.

spans.text: Sangoma moves in closer, then points her finger at my chest.

units.rawText: Sanctifiers function as the Cloud's antivirus. Since you currently don't belong to any sector, they consider you a virus marked for elimination.
units.displayText: Sanctifiers function as the Cloud's antivirus. Since you currently don't belong to any sector, they consider you a virus marked for elimination.

spans.text: Sanctifiers function as the Cloud's antivirus. Since you currently don't belong to any sector, they consider you a virus marked for elimination.

units.rawText: You can spot them easily—they're the ones in white metallic shells. Make sure to steer clear of them whenever you see them.
units.displayText: You can spot them easily—they're the ones in white metallic shells. Make sure to steer clear of them whenever you see them.

spans.text: You can spot them easily—they're the ones in white metallic shells. Make sure to steer clear of them whenever you see them.

units.rawText: So it's all because of me that the Sanctifiers swarmed here?
units.displayText: So it's all because of me that the Sanctifiers swarmed here?

spans.text: So it's all because of me that the Sanctifiers swarmed here?

units.rawText: Yep. After all, your sudden appearance in the Neural Cloud Sector was unwarranted. With such a commotion, there's no way the Sanctifier leader would stay idle...
units.displayText: Yep. After all, your sudden appearance in the Neural Cloud Sector was unwarranted. With such a commotion, there's no way the Sanctifier leader would stay idle...

spans.text: Yep. After all, your sudden appearance in the Neural Cloud Sector was unwarranted. With such a commotion, there's no way the Sanctifier leader would stay idle...

units.rawText: Eh? This is the Neural Cloud Sector? It's not like what I remember...
units.displayText: Eh? This is the Neural Cloud Sector? It's not like what I remember...

spans.text: Eh? This is the Neural Cloud Sector? It's not like what I remember...

units.rawText: Sangoma shakes her head, pointing her finger at a distant location.
units.displayText: Sangoma shakes her head, pointing her finger at a distant location.

spans.text: Sangoma shakes her head, pointing her finger at a distant location.

units.rawText: That's the Neural Cloud Sector. We've already moved away from it to evade the Sanctifiers' attack.
units.displayText: That's the Neural Cloud Sector. We've already moved away from it to evade the Sanctifiers' attack.

spans.text: That's the Neural Cloud Sector. We've already moved away from it to evade the Sanctifiers' attack.

units.rawText: I see...
units.displayText: I see...

spans.text: I see...

units.rawText: Sangoma, I hate to ask this of you... but can you escort me back to the Neural Cloud Sector?
units.displayText: Sangoma, I hate to ask this of you... but can you escort me back to the Neural Cloud Sector?

spans.text: Sangoma, I hate to ask this of you... but can you escort me back to the Neural Cloud Sector?

units.rawText: Oh my, you barely made it out alive, and now you want to go back? What's gotten into you?
units.displayText: Oh my, you barely made it out alive, and now you want to go back? What's gotten into you?

spans.text: Oh my, you barely made it out alive, and now you want to go back? What's gotten into you?

units.rawText: You've shown me that I can trust you to bring me back in one piece.
units.displayText: You've shown me that I can trust you to bring me back in one piece.

spans.text: You've shown me that I can trust you to bring me back in one piece.

units.rawText: ...My, I can't say no to you when you put it like that.
units.displayText: ...My, I can't say no to you when you put it like that.

spans.text: ...My, I can't say no to you when you put it like that.

units.rawText: Umm... Let's see. Judging by the time, those Sanctifiers should have already left the area.
units.displayText: Umm... Let's see. Judging by the time, those Sanctifiers should have already left the area.

spans.text: Umm... Let's see. Judging by the time, those Sanctifiers should have already left the area.

units.rawText: She calls forth her massive scythe, a smile dancing on her lips as she holds it gracefully behind her.
units.displayText: She calls forth her massive scythe, a smile dancing on her lips as she holds it gracefully behind her.

spans.text: She calls forth her massive scythe, a smile dancing on her lips as she holds it gracefully behind her.

units.rawText: Make sure to stay behind me, okay?
units.displayText: Make sure to stay behind me, okay?

spans.text: Make sure to stay behind me, okay?
